speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Good morrow, Mistress Ansell. Good morrow, Master Shakespeare.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good morrow, Master Thwaite. You turned the glass twice.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Twice. The glass is honest, if I am not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The nave was warm enough, sir.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Warm enough to keep a man in his place. That is all I ask of a November morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sir John is gone out. There was no sword-bearer at his back, and he did not speak.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: He takes his own pew and no one else's. I do not hail a man at his prayers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He did not speak. I did not look for it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Nor should you. God give you a quiet day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you, sir.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You did not walk last night. I listened for the boards, and the house was as quiet as a shut shop.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was seated. The candle did the work. One candle.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: One candle, and no pacing. I had begun to think you ill, and then I thought you had only finished with someone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not finished. The dagger is in. The two fathers are still outside.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The beef is to be salted on Tuesday, sir, and the coal comes into the passage. Mistress will not send a boy for the side.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am taking you, if you have a back on Tuesday. You are no use at a price, and you can carry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tuesday the page is done by the time you want the back. A quarter past ten, if the last line comes.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A quarter past ten, and then Leadenhall. You will keep your mouth shut at the stalls until I tell you to open it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is a full thumb short of the notch, sir, and it is still a penny.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, and short. I will not quarrel with a baker on a Sunday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will quarrel with no one today. Dinner is on the board. The fathers can wait on your page until tomorrow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They can wait. I am not dipping the pen.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will not sand a fresh leaf. The old one is on the board. Gib is on the stair. I will not move either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Gib may keep the stair. You may keep the Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tuesday you have the shoulders. Today I have been to church, and that is the day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then come and eat. The house is not keeping a fast because you are between two lines.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will set the board. Do not bring the candle down. It is cold, and it has done its night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It has done its night. I am coming.
